profile.reading: K-Motion Interactive is a sports-technology company that makes 3D motion-capture and biomechanics analysis systems used in golf and baseball swing instruction, based in the Scottsdale area of Maricopa County, Arizona. The coordinates on file sit within the McDowell Mountain Business Park, a multi-tenant office and light-industrial park, and a check of the address today finds a different small business occupying that specific building. There is no indication that K-Motion, or any current tenant at this location, operates server rooms, colocation space, or dedicated data center infrastructure here. This entry describes the business as it is known publicly rather than presenting an ordinary office address as a data center facility.

reading.body:
K-Motion Interactive is not a data center. It is a sports biomechanics and motion-capture analysis company based in Scottsdale, Arizona that serves golf and baseball instruction. The entry was created from a mistagged OpenStreetMap point marking an address in McDowell Mountain Business Park, a multi-tenant office and light-industrial facility. No server rooms, colocation space, or data center infrastructure exist at this location.

Research confirms the company operates as a software and analytics business. The coordinates on file resolve to a different current occupant of the building. No specifications are published for this facility because none exist as compute infrastructure for AI or any other deployment.

This entry should be removed from any inventory of data center capacity in Arizona. It occupies space in a site with zero megawatts of power allocation for compute. Of Arizona's 56 mapped facilities, only 4 publish power figures. Misidentified entries like this one degrade visibility into actual infrastructure available to support AI scaling in the state.
